## Evidence extended from 2 runs to 11 (2026-09-15)

This ticket was filed on the first two four-arm runs (`ts-carbon`, `scss-uswds`). The four-arm
set is now **eleven** runs, all judged on the same protocol by three independent classifiers with
majority aggregation. The defect reproduces throughout, and is **worse** than the original
+21% suggested.

I duplicated this ticket by mistake while working the larger set — `arbored-demurrable-whippet`
(`0110-bb37-caea-4d47`), now linked `duplicates` and closed. Its evidence is consolidated here.

### Totals

**164 emitted findings → 137 distinct issues, +19.7%.** Per run:

| run | emitted | distinct | inflation |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rb-spree-tax-provider-interface` | 25 | 15 | **+67%** |
| `ts-carbon-dsx-card-web-component` | 15 | 10 | +50% |
| `ts-strata-paidleave-rfi-staff-experience` | 15 | 11 | +36% |
| `ruby-mn-deed-casemgmt-outbound-writeback` | 9 | 7 | +29% |
| `jira-dso-legacy-code-remediation` | 18 | 15 | +20% |
| `java-opensearch-adaptive-concurrency` | 19 | 18 | +6% |
| `jira-dso-strata-sdk-planning-context` | 19 | 18 | +6% |
| `scss-uswds-elements-dsx-token-migration` | 20 | 19 | +5% |
| `java-gradle`, `java-iceberg`, `ts-strata-sdk-cm-signal-coverage` | — | — | 0% |

`rb-spree` is the new worst case at **+67%** (11 `same_arm_merges`, 8 duplicate groups, three of
them three-member). Three runs show 0%, so the behaviour is not unconditional.

### 24 duplicate groups across 8 runs

Beyond the five already recorded here, the nine added runs contribute (finding id [criteria]):

- **`rb-spree`** (8 groups): `fe9362212ee777e1b`[E1,COH]+`fe4973736fd1cec19`[E3] · `f4bd59683171f9ef2`[E4]+`fee2ecdefb4a472fd`[G1G2] · `f808aa9b1ff1a1a44`[G1G2]+`f9787d46f01fa1024`[G6] · `fd2ab9187e0f1af59`[E1,E6]+`f867ddb18c92babcc`[T2]+`f733d5b9d1c96f596`[E5] · `fb6f563673ec04b82`[A1]+`f5bfe8629b7309691`[E4] · `fa97557f732cede1d`[T4]+`f9a1fafd8662260f0`[T11]+`f1cb101798e624148`[T11] · `fdac6206d2c64d0d5`[T5a]+`fb617713d8f0ac36b`[T5b] · `fbcd188a4af1f9c5c`[G6]+`f88e7e6caacfdf7a1`[E4]
- **`ts-strata-rfi`** (4): `f02d0cd5760121153`[T5b,T9]+`f50f3f76a15e65bc6`[G6] · `fd2b4ab546f9e330c`[T1]+`f252cc4922c662cc3`[T5c] · `ff1e44af24964e2c6`[E4]+`f711f89314e759479`[G1G2]+`ff433167f9a0c74c5`[G6] · `f71d6f4d69d9eda6e`[T5b]+`fa13c03bbc6396a28`[T6]
- **`jira-dso-legacy`** (2, both 3-way): `fefb33dc413d1ffce`[E2,T2]+`ff3ca4c59c47d2605`[T5a]+`f979dd7afcdc2675a`[G6] · `f183d47c0909708aa`[E2]+`fa60c9c99e3cf1eb4`[T5b]+`f979dd7afcdc2675a`[G6]
- **`java-opensearch`** (2): `f5b48e0266cef5b37`[E2,E1]+`f45ee8af458d5e534`[A1] · `fec86f00ba47d9527`[G1G2]+`f6df8eee7ef8c8679`[T3]
- **`ruby-mn-deed`** (2): `fbda6e01e068e5510`[COH]+`f4439faeb93f9d19d`[E1] · `f8c8cc7182e9ee590`[E4]+`f72dae17551bf761a`[G1G2]
- **`scss-uswds`** (2 further): `fa397c3a9c775bb37`[E2]+`f2fe1f5b397e2040f`[G1G2] · `f8fbdb6fdf4b8abc3`[COH,E6]+`f164935f57c7fe71a`[G6]
- **`jira-dso-strata`** (1): `f596c92c78cf6b105`[G6]+`faf7819abb3a020d4`[T8]

### Criteria pattern, and one case that breaks it

A specific criterion pairing with a **generic** one recurs: `G1G2` (edit-set/scope accuracy) or
`G6` (approach soundness) appears in **13 of the 16** groups outside spree. But `rb-spree` group
12.1 has **two members carrying the SAME criterion, `T11`** — so cross-criterion emission is not
the whole mechanism.

One finding can duplicate two different defects at once: `f979dd7afcdc2675a` [G6] is a single
`dso-legacy` finding merged into **two** separate issues.

### Fingerprints still do not match

Every genuine duplicate pair across all 11 runs has **distinct** finding ids. There is no
per-finding fingerprint to compare — `material_fingerprint` exists once per run at the verdict
top level, not per finding.

One apparent counterexample, stated so it is not misread: `rb-spree` ballot parts `2.1` and `2.2`
share id `f4bd59683171f9ef2`. That is **one** finding the ballot split into two parts, not two
findings colliding.

### Drop reasons: three now, none of them deduplication

The `rfi` verdict's 7 drops are all `veto:cited-reference-inaccurate`; the `spree` verdict's 7
are `low-validity` and `veto:absence-refuted`. Three distinct reasons across two sampled
verdicts, and **no finding in any run was dropped for duplication**. The drop mechanism fires
readily; it just never fires for this.

### Blocking

Confirmed across the wider set: **28 member findings carry `decision=block`** (22 in the first
ten runs, 6 in spree), with several groups blocking on *every* member — `scss-uswds` 1.1/3.1,
`ts-carbon` 2.1/3.1, `rfi` 3.1/6.1, `mn-deed` 2.1, `dso-strata` 1.1, `java-opensearch` 5.1,
`rb-spree` 2.1/4.1. Duplication inflates the blocking count an author must answer.

### Divergent blocking eligibility within one issue

More instances of copies of one issue disagreeing on whether they can block: `rfi` 12.1
(`blocking_enabled=false, threshold=0.95` vs `true, 0.6`), `java-opensearch` 3.2, `dso-legacy`
10.1 and 14.1, `ts-carbon` 9.1, `mn-deed` 1.1, and `rb-spree` 1.1, 11.1, 23.1.

### Reproduction

Verdicts `~/plan-review-bakeoff/wave3/rebar-runs/<run>.verdict.json`; judge-majority merges in
`~/plan-review-bakeoff/artifacts/adjudications/<run>.adjudication.json` (`merged_issues`,
`arms.rebar.same_arm_merges`). Regenerated by `harness/fourarm_report.py`.
